description: The openSMILE SVM baseline on another setup: classical_svm_best's configuration (ComParE 2016 functionals, per-speaker z-scores, rbf, class-balanced, C and gamma chosen on validation per fold; from classical_svm_1, four classes session out) with only the data section changed to three classes (happy+excited, angry, sad), session out (that of threeblock_classes_no_neu3). One configuration, seed 1. How it is read is fixed in RULE_night19c.txt (analyses/night19c_prep_20261019) before any run.
